pages.text: In the evening, the sheep returned to their pen. Pipo's farm had twelve sheep. He had to count to make sure none were missing.
Today, Pipo wanted to count by himself. He stood before the pen with his toes together.
Mrs. Goose landed on the wall. "Counting? I am good at that too! One, two..."
"But say, have you heard about the mill family?" Her chatter began.
Pipo forgot how far he had counted. Back to the start. One, two...
"And you know, the house across the stream!" More chatter interrupted.
The sheep mingled around inside the pen. He could not tell which ones he had counted.
Pipo opened the gate just a little, so only one sheep could pass at a time.
Sheep passed through the gap one by one. "One! Two! Three!" Pipo counted loudly.
"...Twelve! All here!" The last sheep entered, and the gate closed. Mrs. Goose opened her beak. "Counted them already? Then I will finish the mill story!"
